verdict.rationale: A public status page with incident history and postmortems is a fair question for a cloud hosting provider like Railway, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a status page, an incident history, or published postmortems. The community threads describe an outage but never reference a Railway status page or postmortem, so they do not support this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can check a public status page with historical incident postmortems before committing
